title: Pre-Sales Executive (Online)
description:
Company: PropPie (www.proppie.in) Location: Pune (Work from Office) Experience: 13 Years Employment Type: Full-Time Reports To: Head of Sales / Founder About PropPie PropPie is democratizing institutional real estate. We enable individuals to own fractional shares of Grade-A commercial assets—such as IT parks, data centers, and warehouses—starting at just 25 Lakhs, bypassing the traditional 25 Crore barrier to entry. Built on evidence, absolute transparency, and long-term wealth creation, we give investors priority access to vetted commercial spaces. We do not sell dreams; we sell meticulously structured, data-backed fractional ownership. The Role You are PropPie’s energetic online front door. As our Pre-Sales Executive (Online), you will own and manage the virtual funnel. Your objective is not to hit a mindless call volume target, but to qualify serious, sophisticated investors and seamlessly transition them to our sales closure team. You will be the face of our brand on webinars and video calls, requiring you to be highly articulate, presentable, and quick on your feet. What You Will Do Own the Online Engine: Plan, promote, and host live webinars, virtual investor conferences, and Q&A sessions. Manage the entire lifecycle from registrations and reminders to live hosting and 24-hour follow-ups. Drive Engagement: Reach out to inbound leads from digital campaigns and webinar registrations via phone, WhatsApp, email, and video calls. Educate & Simplify: Break down complex financial concepts in plain language. You will explain how fractional ownership works, how rental income and exits function, and clearly outline the associated risks to prospective investors. Qualify with Precision: Assess each lead’s investment capacity, intent, timeline, and decision-making authority. Log all intelligence meticulously into our CRM on the same day. Manage the Calendar: Book and confirm high-quality meetings for the Sales Executives, dispatch the correct pitch materials, and actively reduce meeting no-shows. Value-Driven Nurturing: Maintain regular, helpful touchpoints with leads who aren't ready to invest yet, building trust rather than applying pressure. Market Intelligence: Act as the ear to the ground, relaying investor objections, hard questions, and feedback to the product and sales leadership teams. Who You Are Education & Experience: You hold an MBA (Marketing, Sales, Finance, or General) or a degree in Hospitality Management (BHM). You have 1 to 3 years of professional experience. Exceptional Communicator: You possess highly fluent, confident, and energetic communication skills in English and Hindi (Marathi is a strong plus). You can speak clearly to a live online audience without sounding scripted. Street Smart & Resilient: You read people quickly, handle hard objections with calm professionalism, and remain completely composed when an investor says "no" or asks difficult questions. Fast Learner: You have the cognitive agility to absorb product mechanics, yield calculations, and risk parameters within days and explain them simply to a skeptic. Target-Oriented: You are punctual, presentable, and entirely comfortable being measured by metrics (webinar attendance rates, qualified leads, meetings booked/held, and CRM hygiene). What We DO NOT Require Prior real estate or broking experience. What You Will Learn Working directly with the founding team, you will receive a masterclass in commercial real estate fundamentals, rental yield mechanics, lease structures, and the end-to-end architecture of fractional property ownership.

Key Skills: Sales,Sales support,Field sales,Inside sales,Field,Presales,Development,Business development

Job Purpose To develop and expand sales of industrial safety products across Pune and nearby industrial areas by acquiring new customers, developing existing accounts, achieving sales targets, and strengthening the company's presence in the industrial safety market. 2. Key Responsibilities A. Sales and Business Development Achieve monthly, quarterly, and annual sales and collection targets for the assigned territory. Develop new business opportunities by identifying and approaching industries, factories, manufacturing units, and corporate customers. Promote and sell industrial safety products, including Personal Protective Equipment (PPE), safety helmets, safety shoes, safety goggles, gloves, respiratory protection, hearing protection, and other workplace safety products. Generate new enquiries, prepare quotations, follow up with customers, and convert enquiries into orders. Expand the company's customer base and increase sales turnover in the Pune region. B. Customer Relationship Management Maintain strong relationships with existing customers and develop new customer accounts. Conduct regular customer visits to understand requirements and identify additional sales opportunities. Coordinate with purchase departments, safety officers, EHS managers, plant heads, and other key decision-makers. Market Development Identify potential industrial customers in Pune, Pimpri-Chinchwad, Chakan, Talegaon, Ranjangaon, and other nearby industrial areas. Monitor competitor activities, market trends, customer requirements, and pricing. Identify opportunities to introduce new products and increase the market share of the company's safety products. Develop and implement territory-specific sales strategies to achieve business growth. D. Team Coordination and Reporting Prepare and submit daily, weekly, and monthly sales reports. Maintain records of customer visits, enquiries, quotations, orders, and collections. Coordinate with internal departments, including sales coordination, stores, logistics, and accounts, to ensure smooth order execution. Provide regular updates to management on sales performance, market developments, and business opportunities. E. Take corrective action whenever sales performance falls below the assigned targets. 3. Candidates with an established network among industrial customers in Pune and surrounding industrial areas will be preferred. 4. Self-motivated, target-oriented, and willing to travel extensively within the assigned territory.
